imageSearchVerification.googleSearchByImage: HTTP 200 and redirects to Google Lens search with image dimensions 128x128; real Chromium run reached Google unusual-traffic CAPTCHA after successful image handoff. Suitable as an external user-operated image-search link; not evidence of completed image matching.
imageSearchVerification.googleLensUploadByUrl: Deprecated endpoint returned 404; do not use.
imageSearchVerification.bingImageUrl: Tested q=imgurl and searchbyimage variants silently redirect to images homepage, losing image. Do not advertise these as automatic image handoff.
imageSearchVerification.manualEntryBrowserVerification: Chromium loaded Google Images with aria-label="Search by image" and Bing Images with aria-label="Search using an image" plus "upload an image" on 2026-10-12. Use these actual upload-capable homepages; lens.google and bing.com/visualsearch currently redirect to marketing pages.

legalScope: Assets were retrieved from public official websites for identification and human review. Brand association is verified; registration scope, geography, ownership and authorization are not established by website publication.
